This page is a space to document classroom experiences and reflect on how students learn. Add entries over time, keeping student privacy in mind and leaving out identifying details.

## Reflection notes

::: portfolio-card
### Reflection title

*Date or teaching context:* Add a date or general context without identifying students.

**What happened?**

Describe the activity, student thinking, or teaching moment.

**What did I notice?**

Record questions, strategies, connections, or misconceptions that stood out.

**What might I change next time?**

Note a specific adjustment to the lesson, your explanations, or the support you provide.
:::

## A reflective practice

Use these notes to identify patterns, revise lessons, and consider how different representations or activities can help students make sense of mathematics.
